summary: Daly City Councilmember Teresa Proaño co-wrote a cease-fire resolution with Vice Mayor Daus-Magbual calling for bilateral ceasefire, hostage release, and condemning killings in Gaza.
quote: He headed the ad hoc committee to co-write the draft resolution with fellow Councilmember Teresa Proaño.

summary: Mercury News confirms Daly City passed the Gaza cease-fire resolution on 2024-06-04, the same resolution Proaño co-authored, making it the latest Peninsula city to do so.
quote: Daly City becomes latest city on Peninsula to pass Gaza resolution
